quests.title: Chance Commission

dialogue.t: Ah... Jahoda? What brings you here? Hmm... Is Boss Nefer available right now?
(Just as I thought, he wants to see Boss Nef... Hmm, I should be able to handle a small matter like this myself.)
No need to go to all that trouble. I'm actually here because my boss sent me to help you.
Huh? Wh—What do you mean? Does that mean Boss Nefer has...
You've always wanted to visit the Frostmoon Scions, right?
So, the plan is to befriend Lyylikki first, then ask her to take you to the Frostmoon Scions?
What!? Lady Nefer knew it all along? But I've kept it locked in my heart and barely told anyone...
(Now is the time to use that super cool line that Boss said! What was that line again...? Um... Oh!)
Hehe, Mr. Zompaynco, when you guard a secret, you must also learn to hide the fact that you're guarding one.
Otherwise, no matter how tall a wall you build in your heart, sooner or later the wind will find its cracks.
*Sigh* I was never good at keeping my feelings bottled up, even back when I was still in my hometown.
(YES! I said it! All that practice paid off, heheh!)
Well, now that you know, could you help me make an introduction? I'm an outsider, and I don't want to intrude on Miss Lyylikki.
Don't worry, Lyylikki's really kind. Whether you're a complete stranger or in a form not entirely human, she's always warm and welcoming.
Oh? Is that so...?
But still, calling on her unannounced is rather impolite... Um, but if you happen to know her...
Of course I do! They should be just about done handing out the meals now. Let's head over.
Oh! And by the way, Boss also said we won't be charging you this time.
Oh, thank you so much! I'll go get my things right away.
Jahoda? And... Mr. Zompaynco. What can I do for you?
I... uhh... about that...
He wants to visit the Frostmoon Scions, but can't quite bring himself to ask, so he's hoping you'll help him out.
Yes! Yes, that's exactly it!
G—Greetings, Miss Lyylikki! It's such a pleasure to meet you. Uh... I brought this fossil specimen from Natlan along...
Thank you, but Mr. Zompaynco... umm... We've already met, haven't we? You really don't need to be so formal.
Huh? Then... how did you notice me?
You've always been there when I was distributing meals, haven't you? Wandering around the line, circling back and forth, but never stepping in.
I thought you might want a serving but were too shy to say so, so I quietly set a portion aside for you.
But you've never came around to claim one. In fact, you hadn't shown up today, I was going to ask someone to check and see if you need help or something like that.
Ah... I—I'm so sorry. I've been hesitating, trying to figure out how to say hello...
So, Miss Lyylikki... would it be alright if I paid the Frostmoon Scions a visit?
Of course. We've welcomed a few guests from outside before. But may I ask why?
I'd like to take some photos and notes, look through some records, and if possible... ask someone about the local legends!
I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.
I see... so you're hoping to spend some time in the archives, then? Let me think...
Well, seeing how you seem to have hit it off, I'll consider this commission complete. Let me get back and report to my boss.
Thank you, Miss Jahoda! But... I really must pay you for your trouble. It'd be wrong to have you come all the way here for nothing.
And please be sure to convey my gratitude to Boss Nefer when you return.
Of course. I'll take my leave now, then. You two enjoy your chat.

quests.description: Zompaynco from Natlan seems to be troubled by something…
